justification: `core/src/main/java/com/google/zxing/qrcode/decoder/BitMatrixParser.java` is 245 LOC and concentrates several separable responsibilities in one class: `readFormatInformation()` and `readVersion()` parse metadata, `readCodewords()` performs the full data traversal/unmasking, and `remask()`, `setMirror()`, and `mirror()` manage parser state and matrix transformation. `core/src/main/java/com/google/zxing/qrcode/decoder/Decoder.java:76-117` uses the same class for all of those phases, which is consistent with a monolithic parser that could be split into smaller, more cohesive abstractions.
